warnings: drawing_number was set to 'DE8135', the model code visible on the product front label ('PCB MOUNT COUPLER 5 STUB DTRM | DE8135') and embedded in document_name; no separate 'Drawing Number' field is printed. The footer stamp 'SBL-0033 Rev. No:2 Date: 19.12.2025' was not used, since it carries its own revision/date and reads as a document/form control stamp rather than this product's drawing number.

This drawing confirms the family-wide component numbering pattern: both termination slots (R11, R12) are filled here since both BUS ends are terminated (DTRM), matching the 3-stub and 4-stub DTRM siblings (DE8133 fills R7/R8, DE8134 fills R9/R10).

Front view silkscreen labels GND, J3 STUB, J4 STUB, J5 STUB, J6 STUB, and J7 STUB identify connector positions (no J1 BUS or J2 BUS labels, since both BUS terminals are internally terminated per the schematic) but are not a pin-to-value or labeled table structure, so they were not extracted as a table.

The recommended land pattern shows 11 holes/pads total; unlike sibling drawings DE8105/DE8115/DE8125 (which show a full-pitch dimension exactly twice the half-pitch, plus a separate small stagger offset), this drawing shows a single additional span dimension (23,11 mm) that does not reduce to a clean multiple of the 5,08 mm pitch, so its exact geometric role in the pad layout is not fully resolvable from the printed dimensions alone.
No GD&T feature control frames, datum references, or +/- tolerance callouts were visible on this sheet; tolerances left empty.
